_comment: crafting_items.json - item definitions for crafting materials, crafted items, kits, tools and recipe scrolls, merged into the item database by Scripts/inventory_autoload.gd (Data/items.json entries win). Generated by tools/export_crafting.py from Crafting.xlsx - do not edit by hand; edit the workbook and re-run.

desert_thistle.name: Desert Thistle
desert_thistle.description: A spiky purple flower blooming across the rocky dunes of Lumora Outskirts. The most common foraged ingredient, sweet and slightly bitter. Used as a base for many beginner recipes.

sandroot.name: Sandroot
sandroot.description: An underground tuber with medicinal properties, found buried beneath the sand in nutrient-rich pockets. Earthy aroma when fresh. A step up from Desert Thistle, used in more potent brews and remedies.

venom_cactus_flower.name: Venom Cactus Flower
venom_cactus_flower.description: A striking red bloom from a thorny desert cactus, potent and dangerous. The flower's nectar carries mild venom that becomes a powerful ingredient when properly processed. Requires careful handling to avoid burns.

moonpetal_sage.name: Moonpetal Sage
moonpetal_sage.description: A rare and precious herb with silvery leaves that shimmer faintly in moonlight. Grows only in protected areas near ancient ruins. Highly sought by alchemists and master chefs. One of the rarest ingredients available in Lumora.

tin_ore.name: Tin Ore
tin_ore.description: Pale silvery-white metal easily mined from surface deposits and shallow veins. Soft and workable, perfect for beginners learning blacksmithing and metalcraft.

copper_ore.name: Copper Ore
copper_ore.description: A reddish-orange ore with excellent conductivity and malleability. Found in deeper deposits throughout the desert foothills. More valuable than tin, copper takes longer to harvest but yields stronger tools and weapons.

flint.name: Flint
flint.description: Stone. 20% bonus drop from Tin Veins.

uncut_gem.name: Uncut Gem
uncut_gem.description: A rough, cloudy stone hiding a spark of colour. Found in the old veins beneath Lumora's ruins, where the ancients mined before the sands came.

fir_log.name: Fir Log
fir_log.description: Common softwood harvested from scrubby fir trees scattered across Lumora's dunes and foothills. Light and workable, though not particularly durable. The most abundant wood source for beginning woodworkers.

ironwood_log.name: Ironwood Log
ironwood_log.description: A dense, dark wood found in older trees deeper within the desert regions. Named for its exceptional hardness and durability. Ironwood resists splitting and takes a fine finish, making it ideal for quality crafted goods.

palm_log.name: Palm Log
palm_log.description: Rare and exotic wood from palm trees growing near hidden oasis areas on the edge of Lumora. Palm wood is light yet strong, with beautiful natural grain patterns. Highly prized for creating elegant weapons and fine furnishings.

oasis_date.name: Oasis Date
oasis_date.description: Fruit. 10% bonus drop from Palm Trees.

raw_spider_meat.name: Raw Spider Meat
raw_spider_meat.description: Raw spider meat. Cook it before you eat it.

raw_rat_meat.name: Raw Rat Meat
raw_rat_meat.description: Raw rat meat. Cook it before you eat it.

raw_bat_meat.name: Raw Bat Meat
raw_bat_meat.description: Raw bat meat. Cook it before you eat it.

raw_goblin_meat.name: Raw Goblin Meat
raw_goblin_meat.description: Raw goblin meat. Cook it before you eat it.

raw_human_meat.name: Raw Human Meat
raw_human_meat.description: Raw human meat. Cook it before you eat it.

raw_snake_meat.name: Raw Snake Meat
raw_snake_meat.description: Raw snake meat. Cook it before you eat it.

fletching_feathers.name: Fletching Feathers
fletching_feathers.description: Feather. Bandits, goblin scouts (they carry fletching supplies).

tanning_oil.name: Tanning Oil
tanning_oil.description: A stoppered flask of oil for curing raw hides into leather.

dye.name: Dye
dye.description: A small pot of desert dye, ground from ochre and cactus pulp.

crystal_vial.name: Crystal Vial
crystal_vial.description: An empty glass vial. Every potion and poison needs one.

tin_ingot.name: Tin Ingot
tin_ingot.description: Raw tin ore melted down into a workable ingot. The simplest refining process, perfect for beginners.

copper_ingot.name: Copper Ingot
copper_ingot.description: Copper ore refined into a reddish ingot. More valuable than tin, requires more heat and skill.

bronze_ingot.name: Bronze Ingot
bronze_ingot.description: An alloy of copper and a little tin, harder than either metal alone. The finest metal a Lumora smith can make.

fir_planks.name: Fir Planks
fir_planks.description: Raw fir wood processed into workable planks. The refining process removes bark, splits the wood into usable sections, and prepares it for crafting.

ironwood_planks.name: Ironwood Planks
ironwood_planks.description: Dense ironwood processed into strong, durable planks. The refining requires more skill and effort than fir, as ironwood resists splitting and shaping.

palm_planks.name: Palm Planks
palm_planks.description: Exotic palm wood refined into elegant, lightweight planks. The beautiful golden grain is preserved during refining, making these planks prized by master craftspeople.

soft_leather.name: Soft Leather
soft_leather.description: Raw hide tanned into workable soft leather. The most common leather, perfect for beginners.

hardened_leather.name: Hardened Leather
hardened_leather.description: Hide tanned with sandroot creates a tougher, more durable leather.

reinforced_leather.name: Reinforced Leather
reinforced_leather.description: Hardened leather layered with scarab chitin plates. Flexible as leather, tough as shell.

thread.name: Thread
thread.description: Spider silk spun into strong, fine thread.

woven_cloth.name: Woven Cloth
woven_cloth.description: Basic cloth woven from scraps. The foundation of all cloth armor.

reinforced_cloth.name: Reinforced Cloth
reinforced_cloth.description: Cloth reinforced with sandroot extract creates a more durable fabric.

silken_cloth.name: Silken Cloth
silken_cloth.description: Rare silken cloth for the finest robes.

polished_gem.name: Polished Gem
polished_gem.description: A raw gem polished into a usable component.

gem_setting.name: Gem Setting
gem_setting.description: A finished gem setting ready to be fitted to jewelry or weapons.

tinkered_spring.name: Tinkered Spring
tinkered_spring.description: A precision-crafted spring component used in other tinkering recipes.

bowstring.name: Bowstring
bowstring.description: A twisted cord of spider-silk thread, waxed and tested.

silk_bowstring.name: Silk Bowstring
silk_bowstring.description: A bowstring braided from ordinary and blighted spider silk. It never frays.

broadhead_arrowheads.name: Broadhead Arrowheads
broadhead_arrowheads.description: Wide, wicked arrowheads for hunting or warfare.

cooked_bat_meat.name: Cooked Bat Meat
cooked_bat_meat.description: Small delicate meat from dusk bats. Cooks quickly and has a mild flavor. Preferred by those with refined palates.

cooked_rat_meat.name: Cooked Rat Meat
cooked_rat_meat.description: Lean meat from desert rodents. Quick to cook and easier to digest than spider meat. A staple food for desert travelers.

cooked_spider_meat.name: Cooked Spider Meat
cooked_spider_meat.description: Raw spider meat seared over a fire until the venom cooks out. Tough and chewy, but it knits small wounds.

cooked_snake_meat.name: Cooked Snake Meat
cooked_snake_meat.description: Pale, firm meat from sand vipers. Mild once the venom glands are cut away.

cooked_goblin_meat.name: Cooked Goblin Meat
cooked_goblin_meat.description: Darker, richer meat from humanoid goblins. More substantial than other meats, provides greater satiation but has a stronger taste. A pragmatic choice for those who can stomach it.

cooked_human_meat.name: Cooked Human Meat
cooked_human_meat.description: Meat from fallen bandits and human adversaries. Most humans find this distasteful, but survival in the desert often demands dark choices. Trolls and other races consider it sustenance. Highly nutritious.

desert_thistle_salad.name: Desert Thistle Salad
desert_thistle_salad.description: Cooked meat combined with fresh desert thistles for a balanced meal. The thistles add freshness and slight medicinal properties. A favorite among desert merchants and travelers.

recipe_cook_desert_thistle_salad.name: Recipe: Desert Thistle Salad
recipe_cook_desert_thistle_salad.description: Teaches the Cooking recipe for Desert Thistle Salad. Requires Cooking 3.

sandroot_stew.name: Sandroot & Meat Stew
sandroot_stew.description: A hearty stew combining cooked meat with medicinal sandroot and desert thistles. The sandroot gives it earthy depth and healing properties. This is sustenance for those planning long journeys.

recipe_cook_sandroot_stew.name: Recipe: Sandroot & Meat Stew
recipe_cook_sandroot_stew.description: Teaches the Cooking recipe for Sandroot & Meat Stew. Requires Cooking 5.

viper_kebab.name: Fire-Roasted Viper Kebab
viper_kebab.description: A dangerous and delicious dish. Snake meat seasoned with venom cactus flower creates a paradoxical flavor—fiery and cooling at once. Only expert cooks can balance the venom without creating an actual poison. A dish fit for adventurers.

recipe_cook_viper_kebab.name: Recipe: Fire-Roasted Viper Kebab
recipe_cook_viper_kebab.description: Teaches the Cooking recipe for Fire-Roasted Viper Kebab. Requires Cooking 6.

viper_poison.name: Viper Poison
viper_poison.description: More potent poison from venom cactus and snake venom.

recipe_alch_viper_poison.name: Recipe: Viper Poison
recipe_alch_viper_poison.description: Teaches the Alchemy recipe for Viper Poison. Requires Alchemy 3.

recipe_alch_minor_healing_potion.name: Recipe: Minor Healing Potion
recipe_alch_minor_healing_potion.description: Teaches the Alchemy recipe for Minor Healing Potion. Requires Alchemy 5.

recipe_alch_antidote_essence.name: Recipe: Antidote Essence
recipe_alch_antidote_essence.description: Teaches the Alchemy recipe for Antidote Essence. Requires Alchemy 6.

recipe_alch_stamina_elixir.name: Recipe: Stamina Elixir
recipe_alch_stamina_elixir.description: Teaches the Alchemy recipe for Stamina Elixir. Requires Alchemy 8.

moonpetal_essence.name: Moonpetal Essence
moonpetal_essence.description: Powerful healing potion using rare Moonpetal Sage. Also used by Tailors for the Archmage's Robe.

recipe_alch_moonpetal_essence.name: Recipe: Moonpetal Essence
recipe_alch_moonpetal_essence.description: Teaches the Alchemy recipe for Moonpetal Essence. Requires Alchemy 10.

recipe_alch_elixir_of_insight.name: Recipe: Elixir of Insight
recipe_alch_elixir_of_insight.description: Teaches the Alchemy recipe for Elixir of Insight. Requires Alchemy 12.

desert_tea.name: Desert Tea
desert_tea.description: A simple herbal tea from desert thistles. Refreshing and mildly restorative.

energy_brew.name: Energy Brew
energy_brew.description: A stimulating brew that sharpens reflexes and provides combat advantage.

recipe_brew_energy_brew.name: Recipe: Energy Brew
recipe_brew_energy_brew.description: Teaches the Brewing recipe for Energy Brew. Requires Brewing 3.

courage_draught.name: Courage Draught
courage_draught.description: A bold, meaty brew that increases confidence and damage output in combat.

recipe_brew_courage_draught.name: Recipe: Courage Draught
recipe_brew_courage_draught.description: Teaches the Brewing recipe for Courage Draught. Requires Brewing 4.

fortified_tonic.name: Fortified Tonic
fortified_tonic.description: A more potent tonic combining sandroot with thistle. Requires fermentation to develop properly.

recipe_brew_fortified_tonic.name: Recipe: Fortified Tonic
recipe_brew_fortified_tonic.description: Teaches the Brewing recipe for Fortified Tonic. Requires Brewing 5.

resistance_elixir.name: Resistance Elixir
resistance_elixir.description: A protective potion that grants elemental resistance and poison immunity.

recipe_brew_resistance_elixir.name: Recipe: Resistance Elixir
recipe_brew_resistance_elixir.description: Teaches the Brewing recipe for Resistance Elixir. Requires Brewing 6.

clarity_draught.name: Clarity Draught
clarity_draught.description: A mental enhancement brew that sharpens focus and perception.

recipe_brew_clarity_draught.name: Recipe: Clarity Draught
recipe_brew_clarity_draught.description: Teaches the Brewing recipe for Clarity Draught. Requires Brewing 8.

starlight_cordial.name: Starlight Cordial
starlight_cordial.description: A rare and precious cordial infused with Moonpetal Sage. The most potent brewing creation in Lumora.

recipe_brew_starlight_cordial.name: Recipe: Starlight Cordial
recipe_brew_starlight_cordial.description: Teaches the Brewing recipe for Starlight Cordial. Requires Brewing 10.

copper_pickaxe.name: Copper Pickaxe
copper_pickaxe.description: An upgraded mining tool. Consumes your vendor Miner's Pick.

recipe_tink_copper_pickaxe.name: Recipe: Copper Pickaxe
recipe_tink_copper_pickaxe.description: Teaches the Tinkering recipe for Copper Pickaxe. Requires Tinkering 3.

copper_wrist_cuff.name: Copper Wrist Cuff
copper_wrist_cuff.description: A decorative yet functional wrist cuff. The copper keeps its shine in the desert sun.

recipe_tink_copper_wrist_cuff.name: Recipe: Copper Wrist Cuff
recipe_tink_copper_wrist_cuff.description: Teaches the Tinkering recipe for Copper Wrist Cuff. Requires Tinkering 3.

smoke_grenade.name: Smoke Grenade
smoke_grenade.description: A throwable smoke grenade that creates cover for escape. Consumable.

recipe_tink_smoke_grenade.name: Recipe: Smoke Grenade
recipe_tink_smoke_grenade.description: Teaches the Tinkering recipe for Smoke Grenade. Requires Tinkering 4.

copper_lantern.name: Copper Lantern
copper_lantern.description: A hooded copper lantern with a self-trimming wick. Dimmer than a good torch, but it never needs replacing.

light_source.rain_snuff_message: The rain snuffs out your copper lantern.

recipe_tink_copper_lantern.name: Recipe: Copper Lantern
recipe_tink_copper_lantern.description: Teaches the Tinkering recipe for Copper Lantern. Requires Tinkering 5.

bronze_woodcutters_axe.name: Bronze Woodcutter's Axe
bronze_woodcutters_axe.description: A sturdy woodcutter's axe with a bronze head. Consumes your vendor Woodcutter's Axe.

recipe_tink_bronze_woodcutters_axe.name: Recipe: Bronze Woodcutter's Axe
recipe_tink_bronze_woodcutters_axe.description: Teaches the Tinkering recipe for Bronze Woodcutter's Axe. Requires Tinkering 6.

bronze_charm.name: Bronze Charm
bronze_charm.description: A small bronze charm set with a polished stone. It hums gently.

recipe_tink_bronze_charm.name: Recipe: Bronze Charm
recipe_tink_bronze_charm.description: Teaches the Tinkering recipe for Bronze Charm. Requires Tinkering 6.

explosive_device.name: Explosive Device
explosive_device.description: A dangerous throwable explosive. Very fun when it goes wrong.

recipe_tink_explosive_device.name: Recipe: Explosive Device
recipe_tink_explosive_device.description: Teaches the Tinkering recipe for Explosive Device. Requires Tinkering 7.

bronze_lockpick_set.name: Bronze Lockpick Set
bronze_lockpick_set.description: A set of finely-crafted bronze lockpicks. Permanent.

recipe_tink_bronze_lockpick_set.name: Recipe: Bronze Lockpick Set
recipe_tink_bronze_lockpick_set.description: Teaches the Tinkering recipe for Bronze Lockpick Set. Requires Tinkering 8.

tin_dagger.name: Tin Dagger
tin_dagger.description: A basic tin dagger, perfect for new adventurers. Light and easy to handle, though not particularly durable.

tin_shortsword.name: Tin Shortsword
tin_shortsword.description: A respectable tin shortsword. Better than a dagger, useful for both offense and defense.

recipe_smith_tin_shortsword.name: Recipe: Tin Shortsword
recipe_smith_tin_shortsword.description: Teaches the Blacksmithing recipe for Tin Shortsword. Requires Blacksmithing 2.

recipe_smith_copper_ingot.name: Recipe: Copper Ingot
recipe_smith_copper_ingot.description: Teaches the Blacksmithing recipe for Copper Ingot. Requires Blacksmithing 5.

copper_sword.name: Copper Sword
copper_sword.description: A quality copper sword, significantly better than tin. The copper holds an edge well and feels substantial in hand.

recipe_smith_copper_sword.name: Recipe: Copper Sword
recipe_smith_copper_sword.description: Teaches the Blacksmithing recipe for Copper Sword. Requires Blacksmithing 6.

copper_war_axe.name: Copper War Axe
copper_war_axe.description: A copper war axe for two-handed combat. Slower, harder hits.

recipe_smith_copper_axe.name: Recipe: Copper War Axe
recipe_smith_copper_axe.description: Teaches the Blacksmithing recipe for Copper War Axe. Requires Blacksmithing 7.

copper_armor_plating.name: Copper Armor Plating
copper_armor_plating.description: Copper breastplate armor. Better than cloth, reasonable weight.

recipe_smith_copper_armor_plating.name: Recipe: Copper Armor Plating
recipe_smith_copper_armor_plating.description: Teaches the Blacksmithing recipe for Copper Armor Plating. Requires Blacksmithing 8.

recipe_smith_bronze_ingot.name: Recipe: Bronze Ingot
recipe_smith_bronze_ingot.description: Teaches the Blacksmithing recipe for Bronze Ingot. Requires Blacksmithing 10.

bronze_shield.name: Bronze Shield
bronze_shield.description: A sturdy bronze shield on an ironwood frame.

recipe_smith_bronze_shield.name: Recipe: Bronze Shield
recipe_smith_bronze_shield.description: Teaches the Blacksmithing recipe for Bronze Shield. Requires Blacksmithing 11.

bronze_longsword.name: Bronze Longsword
bronze_longsword.description: The finest blade a Lumora smith can make. It will serve through multiple zones.

recipe_smith_bronze_longsword.name: Recipe: Bronze Longsword
recipe_smith_bronze_longsword.description: Teaches the Blacksmithing recipe for Bronze Longsword. Requires Blacksmithing 12.

pitch_torch.name: Pitch Torch
pitch_torch.description: A fir stave wrapped in pitch-soaked linen. Burns longer and brighter than a vendor torch.

light_source.rain_snuff_message: The rain snuffs out your pitch torch.

fir_firewood_bundle.name: Fir Firewood Bundle
fir_firewood_bundle.description: Split fir logs and a flint striker, tied for carrying. Light it anywhere outside town to make camp.

fir_shortbow.name: Fir Shortbow
fir_shortbow.description: A basic bow for ranged combat. Light and easy to handle, good for beginners learning to shoot.

fir_staff.name: Fir Staff
fir_staff.description: A plain walking staff, favoured by apprentice casters.

recipe_ww_fir_staff.name: Recipe: Fir Staff
recipe_ww_fir_staff.description: Teaches the Woodworking recipe for Fir Staff. Requires Woodworking 4.

recipe_ww_ironwood_planks.name: Recipe: Ironwood Planks
recipe_ww_ironwood_planks.description: Teaches the Woodworking recipe for Ironwood Planks. Requires Woodworking 6.

ironwood_bow.name: Ironwood Bow
ironwood_bow.description: A quality bow made from ironwood. More powerful than a fir bow, with better damage.

recipe_ww_ironwood_bow.name: Recipe: Ironwood Bow
recipe_ww_ironwood_bow.description: Teaches the Woodworking recipe for Ironwood Bow. Requires Woodworking 6.

ironwood_torch.name: Ironwood Torch
ironwood_torch.description: A dense ironwood torch soaked in oil. Slow-burning and bright.

light_source.rain_snuff_message: The rain snuffs out your ironwood torch.

recipe_ww_ironwood_torch.name: Recipe: Ironwood Torch
recipe_ww_ironwood_torch.description: Teaches the Woodworking recipe for Ironwood Torch. Requires Woodworking 6.

ironwood_firewood_bundle.name: Ironwood Firewood Bundle
ironwood_firewood_bundle.description: Dense ironwood that burns long and hot. A proper camp for a proper hunt.

recipe_ww_ironwood_firewood_bundle.name: Recipe: Ironwood Firewood Bundle
recipe_ww_ironwood_firewood_bundle.description: Teaches the Woodworking recipe for Ironwood Firewood Bundle. Requires Woodworking 7.

ironwood_staff.name: Ironwood Staff
ironwood_staff.description: A dense ironwood staff capped with a copper ferrule.

recipe_ww_ironwood_staff.name: Recipe: Ironwood Staff
recipe_ww_ironwood_staff.description: Teaches the Woodworking recipe for Ironwood Staff. Requires Woodworking 9.

recipe_ww_palm_planks.name: Recipe: Palm Planks
recipe_ww_palm_planks.description: Teaches the Woodworking recipe for Palm Planks. Requires Woodworking 11.

palm_resin_torch.name: Palm-Resin Torch
palm_resin_torch.description: A palm torch sealed in the tree's own golden resin. Rain beads off it.

light_source.rain_snuff_message: The rain snuffs out your palm-resin torch.

recipe_ww_palm_resin_torch.name: Recipe: Palm-Resin Torch
recipe_ww_palm_resin_torch.description: Teaches the Woodworking recipe for Palm-Resin Torch. Requires Woodworking 11.

palm_longbow.name: Palm Longbow
palm_longbow.description: The finest bow in Lumora. Fewer shots, but devastating.

recipe_ww_palm_longbow.name: Recipe: Palm Longbow
recipe_ww_palm_longbow.description: Teaches the Woodworking recipe for Palm Longbow. Requires Woodworking 11.

palm_firewood_bundle.name: Palm Firewood Bundle
palm_firewood_bundle.description: Fragrant palm wood that burns sweet and bright. Groups fight over a good palm fire.

recipe_ww_palm_firewood_bundle.name: Recipe: Palm Firewood Bundle
recipe_ww_palm_firewood_bundle.description: Teaches the Woodworking recipe for Palm Firewood Bundle. Requires Woodworking 12.

masters_staff.name: Master's Staff
masters_staff.description: A golden palm staff bound in bronze and crowned with a polished gem.

recipe_ww_masters_staff.name: Recipe: Master's Staff
recipe_ww_masters_staff.description: Teaches the Woodworking recipe for Master's Staff. Requires Woodworking 15.

quiver_of_fir_arrows.name: Quiver of Fir Arrows
quiver_of_fir_arrows.description: A full quiver of fir arrows with flint heads. You'll re-fletch and recover them as you go, so it never runs dry.

recipe_fle_quiver_fir_arrows.name: Recipe: Quiver of Fir Arrows
recipe_fle_quiver_fir_arrows.description: Teaches the Fletching recipe for Quiver of Fir Arrows. Requires Fletching 3.

recipe_fle_broadhead_arrowheads.name: Recipe: Broadhead Arrowheads
recipe_fle_broadhead_arrowheads.description: Teaches the Fletching recipe for Broadhead Arrowheads. Requires Fletching 4.

quiver_of_ironwood_arrows.name: Quiver of Ironwood Arrows
quiver_of_ironwood_arrows.description: High-quality arrows with ironwood shafts and copper tips. These arrows fly true and hit hard.

recipe_fle_quiver_ironwood_arrows.name: Recipe: Quiver of Ironwood Arrows
recipe_fle_quiver_ironwood_arrows.description: Teaches the Fletching recipe for Quiver of Ironwood Arrows. Requires Fletching 7.

recipe_fle_silk_bowstring.name: Recipe: Silk Bowstring
recipe_fle_silk_bowstring.description: Teaches the Fletching recipe for Silk Bowstring. Requires Fletching 8.

quiver_of_broadhead_arrows.name: Quiver of Broadhead Arrows
quiver_of_broadhead_arrows.description: Hunting arrows with broad, wicked heads that leave wounds that won't close.

recipe_fle_quiver_broadhead_arrows.name: Recipe: Quiver of Broadhead Arrows
recipe_fle_quiver_broadhead_arrows.description: Teaches the Fletching recipe for Quiver of Broadhead Arrows. Requires Fletching 10.

quiver_of_palm_arrows.name: Quiver of Palm Arrows
quiver_of_palm_arrows.description: The finest arrows in Lumora. Palm shafts, bronze tips. Works of art.

recipe_fle_quiver_palm_arrows.name: Recipe: Quiver of Palm Arrows
recipe_fle_quiver_palm_arrows.description: Teaches the Fletching recipe for Quiver of Palm Arrows. Requires Fletching 12.

simple_amulet.description: A tin pendant set with a snake scale, hung from a leather cord.

recipe_jc_simple_amulet.name: Recipe: Simple Amulet
recipe_jc_simple_amulet.description: Teaches the Jewelcrafting recipe for Simple Amulet. Requires Jewelcrafting 3.

copper_ring.name: Copper Ring
copper_ring.description: A copper ring with a gem setting.

recipe_jc_copper_ring.name: Recipe: Copper Ring
recipe_jc_copper_ring.description: Teaches the Jewelcrafting recipe for Copper Ring. Requires Jewelcrafting 4.

recipe_jc_gem_setting.name: Recipe: Gem Setting
recipe_jc_gem_setting.description: Teaches the Jewelcrafting recipe for Gem Setting. Requires Jewelcrafting 5.

copper_pendant.name: Copper Pendant
copper_pendant.description: A copper pendant on a silk-thread cord.

recipe_jc_copper_pendant.description: Teaches the Jewelcrafting recipe for Copper Pendant. Requires Jewelcrafting 6.

recipe_jc_bronze_ring.name: Recipe: Bronze Ring
recipe_jc_bronze_ring.description: Teaches the Jewelcrafting recipe for Bronze Ring. Requires Jewelcrafting 10.

bronze_amulet.description: The finest amulet in Lumora, hung on a cord of blighted silk.

recipe_jc_bronze_amulet.name: Recipe: Bronze Amulet
recipe_jc_bronze_amulet.description: Teaches the Jewelcrafting recipe for Bronze Amulet. Requires Jewelcrafting 11.

leather_jerkin.name: Leather Jerkin
leather_jerkin.description: A simple leather jerkin for light protection. Easy to move in, good for rogues and rangers.

leather_boots.name: Leather Boots
leather_boots.description: Comfortable leather boots suitable for desert travel.

leather_bracers.name: Leather Bracers
leather_bracers.description: Protective bracers that help turn aside blows.

recipe_lw_leather_bracers.name: Recipe: Leather Bracers
recipe_lw_leather_bracers.description: Teaches the Leatherworking recipe for Leather Bracers. Requires Leatherworking 3.

leather_armor.name: Leather Armor
leather_armor.description: Improved leather armor with better protection and durability than a jerkin.

recipe_lw_leather_armor.name: Recipe: Leather Armor
recipe_lw_leather_armor.description: Teaches the Leatherworking recipe for Leather Armor. Requires Leatherworking 4.

recipe_lw_hardened_leather.name: Recipe: Hardened Leather
recipe_lw_hardened_leather.description: Teaches the Leatherworking recipe for Hardened Leather. Requires Leatherworking 5.

hardened_leather_armor.name: Hardened Leather Armor
hardened_leather_armor.description: Hardened leather armor gives excellent protection while keeping you mobile.

recipe_lw_hardened_leather_armor.name: Recipe: Hardened Leather Armor
recipe_lw_hardened_leather_armor.description: Teaches the Leatherworking recipe for Hardened Leather Armor. Requires Leatherworking 7.

recipe_lw_reinforced_leather.name: Recipe: Reinforced Leather
recipe_lw_reinforced_leather.description: Teaches the Leatherworking recipe for Reinforced Leather. Requires Leatherworking 10.
